name: GPW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned via a two-pool tournament culminating in an enclosed steel-cage final at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, Genesis (24 October 1999); defended at least once every 30 days.

name: GPW American Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Contested in a ladder match at Genesis; the notch below the World Heavyweight title.

name: GPW World Television Championship
epitaph: Contested in an enclosed-cage match at Genesis; defended weekly on the promotion's own television programs.

name: GPW Brass Knux Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Contested in a no-disqualification, falls-count-anywhere match at Genesis.

events.note: The promotion's own on-air ownership dissolved the division at Blazing Glory 2000 after both the reigning champion, Oyabun, and his own scheduled challenger, Barry Gradwell, left the company.

name: GPW Regional Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own proving ground for younger talent, contested best two-of-three falls at Genesis.

name: GPW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned via a three-pool elimination tournament at Genesis.

events.title: gpw-unified-world-tag-team-gpw-global-1999
events.note: Merged with the American Tag Team Championship at Blazing Glory 2000, in the promotion's own first title-for-title unification match, won by The Coast to Coast Connection over the reigning World champions, XtremeCharisma.

name: GPW American Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Named vacant in the promotion's own first newsletter (28 October 1999); no holder is recorded anywhere in the held record.

events.title: gpw-unified-world-tag-team-gpw-global-1999
events.note: Merged with the World Tag Team Championship at Blazing Glory 2000, in the promotion's own first title-for-title unification match, won by the reigning American champions, The Coast to Coast Connection.

name: GPW Unified World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Created at Blazing Glory 2000 in a title-for-title unification match, merging the promotion's own World and American Tag Team Championships into one lineage; The Coast to Coast Connection defeated the reigning World champions, XtremeCharisma, to become the first Unified champions.
